import Analysis.SpecialFunctions.HurwitzZeta
import Data.Real.Basic
import Algebra.BigOperators
import Polynomial.Bernoulli

open Real Complex Polynomial

theorem lg_target {k : ℕ} {x : ℝ} (hk : k ≠ 0) (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) :
  HurwitzZeta.hurwitzZeta (↑x) (-↑k) = -1 / (↑k + 1) * Polynomial.eval (↑x) (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ) (Polynomial.bernoulli (k + 1))) := by
  have h1 : HurwitzZeta.hurwitzZeta (↑x) (-↑k) = -1 / (↑k + 1) * Polynomial.eval (↑x) (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ) (Polynomial.bernoulli (k + 1))) :=
    by
      let s : ℂ := -↑k
      let a : ℝ := ↑x
      have hs : 1 < s.re := by
        rw [s]
        simp only [Real.cast_neg, Real.cast_one, Real.cast_add, Real.cast_nat, Real.cast_zero]
        exact lt_of_le_of_gt (le_zero_iff.mp (Nat.le_zero_iff.mpr (Nat.succ_pos k))) (by simp)
      have ha : a ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 := hx
      -- Use the identity for Hurwitz zeta at negative integers
      have h2 : HurwitzZeta.hurwitzZeta a s = -1 / (↑k + 1) * Polynomial.eval a (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ) (Polynomial.bernoulli (k + 1))) :=
        by
          -- Use the known formula from analytic number theory
          -- This is derived using Fourier series and properties of Bernoulli polynomials
          -- The following is a direct application of known results
          exact (HurwitzZeta.hasSum_hurwitzZeta_of_one_lt_re a ha s hs).eval_at_s
      exact h2
